# FlashInfer metadata initialization-capacity candidate

## Design

For `ChunkedLocalAttentionSpec`, initialize request-shaped metadata to
`max(max_num_seqs, max_num_batched_tokens)`. A virtual request always contains
at least one scheduled query token, so `max_num_batched_tokens` is a hard upper
bound on the expanded request count. Size page indices to the larger of the
legacy full-context bound and virtual-request capacity times pages per local
chunk. Other attention specs retain the legacy sizes.

This covers `paged_kv_indptr`, `paged_kv_last_page_len`, and
`paged_kv_indices` before execution. It performs no runtime allocation or
pointer replacement, so CUDA graph behavior and common-path allocation
frequency are unchanged.

17-token request into five virtual requests with a configured sequence limit of
one. It checks both request and page requirements against initialization
